author: Just Jared
title: Will 'Survivor' Episode Be Cut Off for Donald Trump's Speech? Exact Timing Revealed, & If You'll Miss Anything - NewsBreak
text:
By Just Jared ,
13 hours ago Survivor 50 returns tonight with a two-hour episode on CBS, however, we’ve learned that the second half of the episode will be interrupted.
Donald Trump is planning to make a speech tonight (April 1), and the exact timeframes have been revealed by CBS. They also confirmed that viewers will not miss any of the episode due to the speech.
Keep reading to find out more…
“The special two-hour Survivor episode (starting at 8 p.m. ET/PT) will resume where it left off immediately following the president’s address for Eastern and Central Time Zone viewers on the CBS Television Network and air in its entirety,” the network confirmed.
They claim the speech will begin at 9pm ET, and will take 20 minutes. They shared that the episode will then pick up exactly where it left off at 9:20 pm ET and run until 10:20 pm ET. It’s unclear if the POTUS will actually stick to the 20 minutes, or if it could run longer or shorter.
Other TV shows across all the networks will also be impacted, including The Masked Singer on Fox, and Chicago Fire on NBC.
